scope: Independent read-only pilot-to-reference100 runner review and actual synthetic CLI integration; no real SVHN run

purpose.pilot: five complete train-only epochs: E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1
purpose.reference100: 100 complete train-only epochs: E4M3 source, naive exponent truncation to E2M3, then mantissa truncation to E2M1

reporting_policy.pilot: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint; also all at last pilot epoch
reporting_policy.reference100: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint and epoch100; incomplete runs also retain last completed epoch

findings: All 18 inherited core/source files match the successful truncation-aware pilot byte for byte, including bit routes, scale copying, STE, recursive passes and exports.
The fresh initialization policy, seed, data split, transforms, A32 activations, FP32 masters/gradients/Adam and 50/75/90 learning-rate schedule remain unchanged.

Only the configured endpoint/experiment namespace/reporting differ from the pilot. The CLI accepts the fixed endpoint 100; Ctrl+C and STOP_AFTER_EPOCH retain the existing reversible stop/resume workflow.
The actual runner executes all 100 synthetic epochs, checks each source cycle, and produces 200 Adam updates, 600 training forwards, 600 train/test metric rows and 300 prediction histograms.
All four original learning-rate phases and both sides of all three schedule boundaries are explicitly checked.
Resume from epoch99 yields the exact CPU model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG and substantive epoch history of the uninterrupted run.
The first strict E4M3 maximum selects one common checkpoint for all modes, and epoch100 is reported separately. Early stop cannot claim PASS or a measured full100 duration.
Both selected checkpoints retain an E4M3 source and two derived exports. All three export modes reconstruct exactly from the saved E4 source with all encoders and G(W) explicitly prohibited.
Former pilot-contract checkpoints and already-completed epoch100 checkpoints are rejected before any optimizer update; source files and synthetic input tensors remain unchanged.
The actual main/check entry passes with only a test-harness CPU device substitution; the production CLI exposes no CPU or synthetic-data bypass.
limits: No real SVHN data was loaded or downloaded and no actual long GPU training was run.
The synthetic 100 epochs use only three images in batches of two plus one; their accuracy and timing are not research results.
CPU exact-resume evidence does not establish bit-exact CUDA resumption with the retained production backend.
Only software behavior is validated here; no required accuracy improvement is imposed.
